# cpanel_email_domain_forwarders (Data Source)

Reads the complete cPanel email domain forwarder inventory through `Email::list_domain_forwarders`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_domain_forwarders" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `forwarders` (Attributes List) The domain forwarders sorted by source domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwarders))

<a id="nestedatt--forwarders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forwarders`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) The normalized destination domain.
- `domain` (String) The normalized source domain.
